name: Urikohime
source:
"Lies are like dreams you've woken up from."

From the tale "Urikohime to Amanojaku."

A darling young girl living in a mountain village. She is quick-witted, and she often throws Shirohime off with her precocious, teasing remarks.

[From [url=https://adabanaitan.com/en/]ANIPLEX.EXE[/url]]
